title: Lying row

steps.text: Lie face down with your forehead resting on the floor and your arms reaching forward.
Lift your arms a little off the floor.
Bend your elbows and pull them back and down toward your sides, so your arms make a W. Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
steps.cue: Elbows back and down to a W. Squeeze.

steps.text: Reach your arms forward again slowly. Keep your neck long.

mistakes: Lifting the chest high and straining the lower back.
Shrugging the shoulders toward the ears.
regression: Keep your arms resting on the floor and just slide your elbows back.
stopIf: Stop if you feel pain in your shoulders, neck or lower back.

anatomy.why: The upper back draws the shoulder blades together as the elbows lift.
